title: Examples and test models find their data beside their file, not in the working directory
author: Claude-JG
description: 17 test models, 4 examples and a performance model read their input data by paths relative to the working directory ('testData/...', '../Examples/testData/...', '../TestModels/testData/...'), so they ran only when started in their own directory or by a runner that changes into a sibling of it; objectFFRFreducedOrderStressModesTest.py chose between two paths by testIsActive. Decided: they build the path from os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), and runPerformanceTests.py sets __file__ of each model as runTestExamples.py does (#3284).
releaseNotes: The examples, test models and performance models that read data from testData find it beside their own file (by __file__) instead of in the working directory, so they run from any directory; runPerformanceTests.py sets __file__ for each model.
